claims.text: Neural-network potentials can accurately determine melting temperatures across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Gaussian-process regression can accurately determine melting temperatures across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approaches can accurately determine enthalpies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approaches can accurately determine entropies of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approaches can accurately determine volume changes at melting across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approaches can accurately determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across the high-entropy-alloy family.
The proposed machine-learning approaches determine these thermodynamic properties efficiently.
The machine-learning models are trained using experimental or computational data.
The models learn patterns in training data that enable prediction of thermodynamic properties.
The approach improves predictive accuracy relative to prior experimental and computational methods.
The approach improves efficiency relative to prior experimental and computational methods.
The applicability of the approach is limited to high-entropy alloys.
The applicability of the approach is limited to high-temperature conditions.
